title: Carrot Raisin Salad With Pineapple
ingredients: Mix it all together and chill.
text:
Carrot Raisin Salad
Ingredients
4 c 
fresh carrots, finely shredded
1 can(s) 
(20) crushed pineapple, with juice
1 c 
raisins
3/4 c 
mayonnaise
1 Tbsp 
sugar
1/2 Tbsp 
fresh lemon juice

Mix it all together and chill.

From Chick Fil-A
